article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Kent Jackson’s 25 points helped North Florida defeat Little Rock 99-87 on Saturday. Jackson added three steals for the Ospreys (3-3). Ayuba Bryant Jr. scored 21 points while shooting 8 of 13 from the field and 5 for 7 from the line, and added six rebounds. B.J. Plummer had 13 points and shot 5 of 7 from the field and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line. Jalen Lynn finished with 20 points for the Trojans (2-4). Little Rock also got 17 points from Jah’likai King. Aaron Clark also had 14 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
